meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 为选定的 NanoClaw agent 组装上免密钥的 Tavily 远程 MCP 服务,提供两个工具:tavily_search(网页搜索)与 tavily_extract(网页提取);任何支持 MCP 的 provider 都能识别,Tavily 的 Crawl、Map、Research 会被过滤掉。
howto.when: 当你想在没有 API 密钥的情况下,给某个 agent 组装上 Tavily 网页搜索或 URL 提取时使用;对非 Claude provider 的组收益更大。

say.text: 给我选定的 agent 组装上免密钥的 Tavily 搜索
say.note: 会注册 tavily MCP 服务并重启该组

say.text: 跑一次 max_results 为 1 的 Tavily 搜索,看能不能成功
say.note: 用来验证安装是否生效

say.text: 免密钥额度用完了,帮我把 Tavily 换成付费 API key
say.note: 会写入升级说明并通过 OneCLI 存密钥

howto.what_en: Installs a keyless Tavily MCP server into selected NanoClaw agent groups, exposing tavily_search and tavily_extract. Any MCP-capable provider picks it up; it helps non-Claude providers most. Crawl, Map and Research are filtered out.
howto.when_en: Use when adding Tavily web search or URL extraction to an agent group without an API key. Adds the most for groups on providers other than Claude.

say_en.text: Add keyless Tavily search to my selected agent groups
say_en.note: Registers the tavily MCP server and restarts each group

say_en.text: Run one Tavily search with max_results 1 and tell me if it works
The keyless allowance ran out — switch Tavily to a paid API key
say_en.note: Writes upgrade instructions and stores the key via OneCLI
